item.title: Machine Learning Approaches to Early Detection of Bovine Respiratory Disease
item.description:
Overview An internet-of-things (IoT) methodology that ingests real-time biometric telemetry to catch the onset of BRD in livestock populations.

Problem Motivation BRD is the leading cause of morbidity in commercial feedlots; subjective visual observation chronically misses early-stage infections.

Methodology Deployed an ensemble Random Forest utilizing continuous stream data (rumination activity, core temperature, and movement velocity) gathered from wearable sensors.

Key Findings The model accurately triggered preemptive quarantine protocol 48 hours prior to the onset of severe, visually observable symptoms with 92% specificity.
